functionalReqs: Score each transaction in real time; approve, step-up or block
Rules engine for analysts alongside the model
Retrain with chargeback and analyst labels
hints: Labels show up 30–90 days later. How does that affect training and evaluation?
The most useful features are aggregates: transactions in the last 10 minutes, new device, distance from usual location. Where are they computed?

Streaming feature pipeline (Flink) into an online feature store (velocity counts, device/IP reputation, graph features like shared devices) → gradient-boosted model + rules → decision service with thresholds per risk band; delayed labels from chargebacks plus analyst reviews; time-based train/test splits; monitor fraud rate, approval rate and drift; shadow mode for new models.
nonFunctionalReqs: Decision in under 100 ms in the payment path
Very low false-positive rate (blocked good customers)
Explainable decisions for analysts and regulators
problemStatement:
Design a **real-time fraud detection** system for a payments app that decides whether to approve, challenge (OTP) or block each transaction.

Fraud is rare, labels arrive weeks later (chargebacks), and fraudsters change tactics quickly.
title: Design a Fraud Detection System
